text_block_list.text:
In the mile GⅠ race, North Flight achieved
a truly magnificent victory in her
own "best coordinate."

When I asked if there was anything she wanted me to do
to celebrate her great achievement—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, there's something...
that I've wanted to do for a very long time."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If it's with you, Trainer,
we can definitely make it a reality...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
thank you so much for coming today!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Welcome to "our" "Best Coordinate Collection"!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: “Just as the Mile is my best fit, every Umamusume has her own ideal match.”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Distance, track conditions, clockwise, counter-clockwise, starts,
burst of speed down the final stretch... Everyone
has something that makes them shine.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
We want to show everyone our best coord to our hearts' content. We want you to see it!
That's the feeling we put into this collection.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Now, feast your eyes on the brilliance of these Umamusume!
—Please, enjoy it to your heart's content!

“――Whoa! She's making her move here!
Now, entering the final stretch!
Can she go all the way wire-to-wire――”

Footage of past races played on the paddock screen.
With clips of their own runs in the background,
the Umamusume appeared in their racewear—heads held high.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I lost this race, but...
I gave it everything and showed my true worth.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
The late kick I've believed in and polished all this time!
I fell short of the winner by just a nose, but...
Next time, I will definitely blow past them to victory!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh... I hadn't paid much attention to her, but...
to think she had such an incredible turn of foot.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I only paid attention to girls with a big impact...
but everyone's so interesting.
I wonder what kind of girl will show up next?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Everyone's... really shining out there!

text_block_list.name: Quiet Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
F-Flight-chan...!

The one who called out to North Flight
was an Umamusume who seemed somewhat lacking in confidence.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "You participated too! But... you don't really like standing out, do you...?"

text_block_list.name: Quiet Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Th-that's true, but...
Still... if Flight-chan is hosting it,
I want to do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Quiet Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Remember how you came up with
an outfit that would suit me, Flight-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Quiet Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You told me so many times... that someone like me still has wonderful qualities...
It made me so, so happy...

text_block_list.name: Quiet Umamusume
text_block_list.text: A-And then... you know. I thought... maybe I should try finding my own good qualities too. And then... I found one!

text_block_list.name: Quiet Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You know, no matter how heavy the track gets,
I can run without losing my footing...!

text_block_list.name: Quiet Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Everyone watched me,
and they told me I was amazing...
...Thank you. For giving me confidence...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
choice_data_list: I'm glad we could make it happen.
I'm glad we could make it happen.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next is...
my turn, isn't it♪

After this, North Flight was scheduled to run
in a mile race to bring even more excitement
to her collection.
choice_data_list: Go out there and show them your dazzling brilliance.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooh...!
So dazzling...--

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! How was it?
Did you see me shine...!

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text: Fu-chan...!

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
Fu-chan...!
You look so wonderful.

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
You truly believed in yourself to the very end, didn't you?
...Congratulations, Fu-chan...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Big sis...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: (Thank you for always watching over me. I finally made it—to the me I truly love!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Alright! Today's opponent is—oh my!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's so gorgeous...
It makes my heart flutter♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I-I'll be in your care...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's been a while, so I'm nervous... but! I can... bloom in the mile too!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware of your accomplishments, Flight-san.
...It is an honor to compete against you.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...I need to retie my scarf
and take on this challenge... right!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Flight-san!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Craft-chan.
Thank you for participating today!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Likewise.
All my upperclassmen whom I look up to are here, so my heart's racing, but—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'll take everything from everyone's runs to heart and carry it forward into the future!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I can't wait to see
what kind of outfit you'll wear!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Then let's run together!
—In our absolute best coordinates!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooh...!
So dazzling...--

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu.
Hey, I'm sure everyone else... felt it too, right?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(When I can shine as my true self—
It makes me feel like flying!)

"And all that remained of the Best Coordinate Collection...
was the grand finale, where the organizer, North Flight, took to the stage."
(Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, Trainer!
Shall we go?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's about time
you realized it yourself.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
To speak of the show that is me...
You are an absolute necessity.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Now, hold your head high!
Let us take pride in—"us"!
